keyword.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵的区别

title.en: Electric 40 vs Electric 50 Concrete Pump keeps its own figures; Variable-frequency drive is only the picture
title.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵有何不同保留自己的数字，「变频器」只是配图

description.en: Electric 40 vs Electric 50 Concrete Pump. 45 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Variable-frequency drive.
description.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵有何不同。45 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「变频器」。

h1.en: Electric 40 vs Electric 50 Concrete Pump keeps its own figures; Variable-frequency drive is only the picture
h1.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵有何不同保留自己的数字，「变频器」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Electric 40 and Electric 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps built in Xingtai. Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive.
directAnswer.zh: 电动40和电动50是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的混凝土泵。电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive. The picture shows Small variable frequency drive. Electric 40 and Electric 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps built in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Dimensions: Electric 40 lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Electric 50 is not Electric 40 with a new badge. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive。画面是Small variable frequency drive。电动40和电动50是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的混凝土泵。理论输送量：电动40标出 21 m³/h；电动50标出 26 m³/h。整机重量：电动40标出 2300 kg；电动50标出 2800 kg。电动50有、电动40没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。

body.en: Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. Theoretical output: Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Main unit weight: Electric 40 lists 2300 kg. Electric 50 lists 2800 kg. Electric 40 lists entries that Electric 50 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. It lists a third stone row and a different hydraulic-pump name. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m。最大出口压力：电动40标出 23 MPa；电动50标出 30 MPa。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 50 lists 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine-stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. The same shown value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Electric 50 lists entries that Electric 40 does not: Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50.
body.zh: 电动50标出 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。液压泵：电动40标出 Kawasaki 112；电动50标出 Kawasaki 140。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Hopper volume is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Hydraulic pump: Electric 40 lists Kawasaki 112. Electric 50 lists Kawasaki 140. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动40标出 45 kW；电动50标出 55 kW。外形尺寸：电动40标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；电动50标出 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。电动40有、电动50没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same motor power as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 45 kW。电动50标出 55 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same theoretical output as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 21 m³/h。电动50标出 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 23 MPa。电动50标出 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is fine-stone pumping (h / v) missing on Electric 50?
question.zh: 为什么电动50没有细石输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric 50 page does not list that label. Electric 40 lists 120 m / 360 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive.
answer.zh: 电动50这一页没有标出这个标题。电动40标出的是 120 m / 360 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable-frequency_drive画面里印出的数字。
